background: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this approved railway crossing GAME SAMPLE into a clean reusable background plate. parts: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce a professional game asset sheet on GENUINE TRANSPARENT background, matching exactly the painted metal railway crossing objects from reference sample. Four isolated textless assets in a strict 2x2 equally sized cell grid with generous transparent gutters, no overlap and no labels. Canvas wide 3:2. TOP LEFT cell: a single long thin HORIZONTAL red-and-white diagonal striped boom barrier arm, front view, rounded left end, circular hinge at RIGHT end, no motor, no sentence panel. TOP RIGHT cell: single dark blue-grey railway crossing motor pedestal with circular pivot hub on face, small red signal lamp on top, squat yellow-black striped base, same front view as reference, no arm attached. BOTTOM LEFT cell: one wide clean pale ivory enamel word button with dark blue-grey metal beveled rim, four corner screws, blank center, front view slight top surface visible, 2.7:1 aspect. BOTTOM RIGHT cell: long slim blank dark blue-grey metal sentence panel FRAME with four corner screws and one uninterrupted pale ivory inset interior, width to height ratio 6.5:1; no pre-drawn divisions, no text. Keep soft dimensional edges, subtle highlights, crisp silhouette and navy-grey metal materials matching reference. No wood, no brown UI, no ground, no background color or checkerboard, no shadows extending far outside objects. Each complete object contained exclusively in its own quadrant. Absolutely no lettering, numerals, characters, road or scenery.
